meta.title: Kiln — drag and drop, download a clean Next.js repo
meta.description: Kiln is a site builder whose output does not look like builder output. The folder you download contains no Kiln code — only Next.js, React and Tailwind.

props.title: Drag and drop. Download a Next.js repo that looks hand-written.
props.subtitle: Kiln is a site builder, but its output does not look like builder output. There is not a single line of Kiln in the folder you download — only Next.js, React and Tailwind.

props.title: Three claims, all three measurable
props.subtitle: Each one is guarded by a test that runs on every change.

items.title: The output really is clean
items.text: The block and lib files in the downloaded repo are byte-for-byte the files the studio runs. No transformation, no code generation.

items.title: Responsive from the schema
items.text: You do not write media queries. You write base, md and lg values in JSON; the system turns them into Tailwind classes. The scale is fixed — no arbitrary values.

items.title: 0 KB of animation
items.text: Scroll reveals and word-by-word headings are plain CSS transitions. No Framer Motion; the only animation code that reaches the browser is a small IntersectionObserver.

props.title: How it works
props.subtitle: Three steps. No setup wizard, no account.

items.title: 1. Edit
items.text: Drag blocks in, type your copy, pick colours and type from the theme panel. Changes land on the canvas instantly and are kept in your browser.

image.alt: Block list and canvas in the Kiln editor

items.title: 2. Download
items.text: The download button produces a zip. Inside it: only the blocks you used, your content as JSON, and a Next.js skeleton ready to run.

items.title: 3. npm run dev
items.text: Unzip, install, run. It builds with zero warnings. From there it is your repo — write blocks by hand or replace all of it.

image.alt: npm run dev output in a terminal

props.title: Four demos
props.subtitle: All built from the same block library with different themes. Each one can be downloaded and run.

about.title: Kiln
about.text: An open-source site builder. Drag and drop in the browser, download a clean Next.js repository. No account, no server, no database.
